name: Can commercial renovations improve a business's energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: Can commercial renovations improve a business's energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, commercial renovations can significantly improve energy efficiency. Upgrades often include installing energy-efficient windows and doors, updating HVAC systems, adding better insulation, and switching to LED lighting. These improvements reduce operating costs, lower the building's environmental impact, and can lead to a more comfortable interior environment for employees and customers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, renovations can improve energy efficiency through HVAC upgrades, insulation, LED lighting, and energy-efficient windows.
